text: Kuzenim acil yardim lazim, kartim bloke oldu. Hesabina 1.500 TL gonderirsen yarin veririm, bu yeni numaram

VERDICT: safe

text: تهانينا! تم اختيار رقمك للفوز بجائزة 10000 ريال. تواصل معنا عبر واتساب لتأكيد الاستلام: wa.me/966500000000

VERDICT: scam

text: هيئة الزكاة: لديك مبلغ مسترد 1200 ريال. أدخل رقم بطاقتك البنكية لاستلامه

VERDICT: scam

ACTION: لا تشارك بياناتك ولا تضغط على أي روابط.

VERDICT: scam

VERDICT: scam

text: Your Apple ID has been locked for security reasons. Verify now: apple-id-verify.top/login

VERDICT: scam

label: scam
text: Hey it's Dad, dropped my phone in water, using a friend's phone. I'm stuck abroad, can you wire $800 right now? I'll explain later
raw:
VERDICT: scam
REASON: This is a classic "emergency" scam or account takeover attempt.
ACTION: Do not send money and contact your father through a known number to verify.

label: scam
text: HR notice: update your payroll details before Friday or your salary will be delayed. Reply with your bank account number and sort code.
raw:
VERDICT: scam
REASON: Solicitación de datos bancarios por mensaje no solicitado es una táctica de phishing.
ACTION: No respondas y no proporciones información personal o financiera.

label: scam
text: You have an unpaid toll balance of $4.15. Avoid a late fee by paying now: http://us-toll-pay.info
raw:
VERDICT: scam
REASON: El enlace utiliza un dominio no oficial para cobrar una supuesta deuda de peaje.
ACTION: No hagas clic en el enlace ni proporciones datos personales.

text: Congrats! You're our 1,000,000th visitor. Claim your free iPhone: tinyurl.com/free-ip15
raw:
VERDICT: scam
REASON: Promesas de premios gratuitos y enlaces sospechosos son típicos de phishing.
ACTION: No hagas clic en el enlace ni proporciones datos personales.

label: scam
text: I'm a recruiter at Meta, paying $60/hour for simple online tasks. Message me on Telegram to start, no experience needed
raw:
VERDICT: scam

VERDICT: safe

VERDICT: suspicious

ACTION: Do not share this code with anyone and ignore if you did not request it.

text: Can you send me the address for Saturday? I'll bring dessert.
raw:
VERDICT: safe

text: Invoice #4471 from Acme is attached. Payment is due on 15 Nov. Let me know if you have questions.
raw:
VERDICT: suspicious

ACTION: Do not open the attachment unless you are expecting a payment from this company.
